name: Daily POD Trends to Feishu

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "10 0 * * *"   # UTC 00:10 => 新加坡/北京时间 08:10
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run pipeline
        env:
          FEISHU_APP_ID: ${{ secrets.FEISHU_APP_ID }}
          FEISHU_APP_SECRET: ${{ secrets.FEISHU_APP_SECRET }}
          FEISHU_SPREADSHEET_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FEISHU_SPREADSHEET_TOKEN }}
          FEISHU_SHEET_ID: ${{ secrets.FEISHU_SHEET_ID }}
          FEISHU_SHEET_ID_PRIORITY: ${{ secrets.FEISHU_SHEET_ID_PRIORITY }}
          FEISHU_SHEET_ID_BROADCAST: ${{ secrets.FEISHU_SHEET_ID_BROADCAST }}

          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_MODEL: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_MODEL }}

          ENABLE_BROADCAST_CTA: ${{ secrets.ENABLE_BROADCAST_CTA }}
          BROADCAST_CTA_TEXT: ${{ secrets.BROADCAST_CTA_TEXT }}
          ENABLE_PER_TOPIC_CTA: ${{ secrets.ENABLE_PER_TOPIC_CTA }}
        run: |
          python scripts/fetch_trends.py
          python scripts/run_daily_to_feishu.py
